scope: Boolean adapter pipeline, not complete Huak integration or rendering. Clipper returns native Huak Path; Skia returns a C element buffer without final Huak Path reconstruction.

validation.sampling: 31 x 29 f64 winding probes; each cubic sampled at 64 subdivisions, near-reference-boundary points excluded; plus explicit known-result local-feature probes
validation.guarantee: bounded check, not proof of topological equality or Hausdorff tolerance
validation.input_quantization_guard: max f32 roundtrip error <= tolerance/4 is necessary, not sufficient; diagnostic only, not a production guard

modes.median_definition: middle pair average for four trials
middle pair average for four trials

memory.method: Separate /usr/bin/time -l processes using same stripped ReleaseFast executable; CASE/ENGINE filter, no reference coverage or JSON export; failed restricted sysctl runs excluded
memory.note: All samples equal startup baseline. No distinguishable engine memory difference; baseline subtraction is not allocator peak. Shared linked executable includes both libraries.

method_caveats: N-1 replacement frees are in each timed loop; last result is freed after timing.
Primitive canonicalization, region composition and rendering are outside these measurements.
Quad/conic output handling exists in the harness but was not exercised by this corpus.
Input quantization guard and sampled coverage do not guarantee Hausdorff tolerance.
